The main takeaway from our work is that
the k1-clustering algorithm is very efficient in identifying jets in the DIS and e+e− processes.
the multi-jet rates are not sensitive to the choice of the renormalization scale and scheme (in the case of DIS) as well as to the choice of a parton distribution function.
